title: GenericCameraSources
description: Read-only generic camera configuration list (RTSP / ONVIF / Hikvision ISAPI / Dahua / Tapo). Credentials are NEVER stored in this JSON; they live in the OS keychain / Windows Credential Manager under target generic-camera:<id>.

id.description: Stable UUID identifying the camera and its OS credential target generic-camera:<id>.

host.description: Private LAN IP or .local hostname (non-local hosts require explicit user confirmation).

path.description: RTSP stream path (used only when kind is rtsp).

channel.description: 1-based camera channel for ISAPI / Dahua NVR or multi-channel cameras.

mainStream.description: Optional explicit main-stream go2rtc source template (may use {user} and {pass} placeholders, never raw secrets).

subStream.description: Optional explicit sub-stream go2rtc source template (may use {user} and {pass} placeholders, never raw secrets).
